hypothesis: The CE hash services and native request parser compute MD5, SHA and SM3 digests and HMAC that match host OpenSSL, with reserved-selector and retained-error handling.
conclusion: The model does not establish the physical engine's digest byte order.
narrative: checks/crypto-digests.py (removed from the repository as a finished bring-up check covered by a733-ce-modes.py) authenticated cached source hashes, compiled the actual controller, services and native request parser with sanitizers and compared results with host OpenSSL through hashlib and hmac. Its descriptor model implemented compression independently of the production code. It passed 210 stream cases and 27 application cases, with reserved-selector and retained-error checks; the host producer supports the extended digest selectors. Independent review covered the erasure ownership rules, descriptor methods, padding, test model and shared host-parser patch.

hypothesis: The linked producer erases copied request data after copy refusal or post-copy expiry, preserves producer-owned request bytes and publishes successful requests.
conclusion: Host and emulation evidence only; no CE cryptographic operation is physically qualified.
narrative: checks/crypto-modes-native.py and checks/crypto-upload-erasure.py (both removed as finished bring-up checks covered by a733-ce-modes.py) executed linked AArch64 instructions. The modes check passed linked MD5/SM3 upload and publication checks (digests-native/) and complete CPU-erasure and producer-ownership checks (staging-native/); the erasure check passed linked producer refusal, post-copy expiry and successful publication, with SHA-256 and SM3 results in upload-sha-native/ and upload-erasure-native/. CE completion, RTOS and authority callbacks, board-liveness and counter observations are modeled. checks/crypto-staging.py (retained) compiles the actual orchestration and request code with sanitizers, checks complete CPU erasure, unchanged session state, normal orchestration, operation failures and final publication refusal; the corrected ownership check is staging-ownership-check/.
